lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Do you have the slides for the nine o'clock meeting?
lines.zh: 你有九点会议的幻灯片吗？

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: I sent them to you last night. Did you check your email?
lines.zh: 我昨晚发给你了。你看邮件了吗？

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Not yet. My laptop decided to restart for an update.
lines.zh: 还没。我的笔记本电脑突然重启更新。

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: That always happens at the worst time.
lines.zh: 这总是发生在最糟糕的时候。

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Can you share your screen if mine is still not working?
lines.zh: 如果我的还是不行，你能共享你的屏幕吗？

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Of course. I will also bring a printed copy, just in case.
lines.zh: 当然。我还会带一份打印版，以防万一。

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: You are a lifesaver. I owe you lunch.
lines.zh: 你救了我。我欠你一顿午饭。

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: I will remember that. Let's go, everyone is waiting.
lines.zh: 我记住了。走吧，大家都在等。

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Deep breath. We have prepared well for this.
lines.zh: 深呼吸。我们准备得很充分。

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Exactly. All we have to do is explain it clearly.
lines.zh: 没错。我们只需要把它讲清楚。
